title: ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2609.35954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model post-training generates self-generated rollouts through reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation, yet this experience is often treated as stale once the policy advances. Historical rollouts can remain compatible with a later policy while preserving behaviors that the policy no longer expresses reliably. However, they may also contain mistakes, abandoned attempts, and redundant actions that should not be imitated, motivating finer-grained selective supervision. We introduce ROSS (Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision), which preserves the full historical trajectory as context while applying loss only to selected model-generated continuations. Across domain-specific reinforcement learning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning, ROSS consistently improves upstream checkpoints and outperforms baselines across mathematics, code generation, instr

translated_title: ROSS：通过选择性监督从自生成rollout序列中再学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的后训练过程通过强化学习和同策略蒸馏生成自生成的rollout序列，然而这些经验往往在策略更新后就被视为过时数据而丢弃。历史rollout序列可能与后续策略仍然兼容，同时保留着策略已无法稳定表达的行为；但它们也可能包含不应被模仿的错误、被放弃的尝试和冗余动作，这促使我们需要更细粒度的选择性监督。我们提出了ROSS（通过选择性监督从自生成rollout序列中再学习），该方法将完整的历史轨迹保留为上下文，同时仅对选定的模型生成延续部分施加损失。在领域专用强化学习、多教师同策略蒸馏和智能体强化学习等场景中，ROSS能够持续提升上游检查点的性能，并在数学、代码生成、指令遵循等任务上超越基线方法。
tldr: ROSS通过将完整历史rollout轨迹保留为上下文、仅对选定的模型生成延续施加损失的选择性监督方式，有效再利用历史自生成经验，在强化学习、多教师蒸馏和智能体学习中持续提升大语言模型性能。
en_tdlr: ROSS enables effective relearning from historical self-generated rollouts by preserving full trajectories as context while applying loss only to selectively chosen model-generated continuations, consistently improving LLM performance across RL, multi-teacher distillation, and agentic learning.
